The **best off-grid solar system** depends on whether you're powering an entire house, a cabin, an RV, or just essential appliances.

For a full-time off-grid home, I recommend a system built around **LiFePO4 (lithium iron phosphate) batteries, a 48V hybrid inverter, and high-efficiency monocrystalline solar panels**.

## What size system do you need?

These are rough starting points for a reasonably sunny location, not final engineering specifications.

| Application | Solar panels | Battery storage |
|---|---:|---:|
| Small cabin | 2–4 kW | 5–10 kWh |
| Medium off-grid home | 6–10 kW | 20–40 kWh |
| Large off-grid home | 12–20 kW | 40–80+ kWh |

For year-round off-grid living, I would also include a backup generator, especially in areas with cloudy winters.
